description: This file implements a DailyProxyApp class for managing a video conferencing session, including participant audio handling, subscription management, and event handling, using asyncio for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: DailyProxyApp
classes.description: A class managing a video conferencing session, handling participant events, audio streams, and subscriptions.

methods.name: completion_callback
methods.description: Creates a callback to set the result of a future based on asyncio task completion.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DailyProxyApp with sample rate and sets up client and audio sources.

methods.name: on_joined
methods.description: Handles the event when a participant joins the meeting.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the asyncio event loop, manages signals, and joins the meeting.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Leaves the meeting and cancels audio tasks.

methods.name: update_subscriptions
methods.description: Updates participant and profile subscriptions asynchronously.

methods.name: _create_audio_task
methods.description: Creates an audio processing task and queue.

methods.name: _cancel_audio_task
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing audio task gracefully.

methods.name: capture_participant_audio
methods.description: Subscribes to a participant's audio stream.

methods.name: send_audio
methods.description: Sends audio data through the audio source.

methods.name: _audio_data_received
methods.description: Callback for receiving audio data from a participant.

methods.name: _audio_task_handler
methods.description: Continuously processes queued audio data and sends it.

methods.name: on_participant_joined
methods.description: Handles participant join events, subscribing to Pipecat's audio.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the application and starts the event loop.
